info.title: TradeChameleon API
info.description:
Multi-tenant, white-label training trading platform.

**Tenant** is resolved from the `*.localhost` subdomain, `?tenant=`, the `X-Tenant-Id` header or the default (aurora).

**Auth**: `POST /api/auth/token` with `trader@aurora.test` / `demo`, then use the `accessToken` as a Bearer token. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details.
